name: get_schema
description: Return the JSON schema (field names, types, and allowed enum values) that the extracted output must conform to.

name: validate_extraction
description: Validate a candidate extraction against the target schema. Returns which required fields are missing and which fields have an invalid enum value or wrong shape. Does NOT reveal the correct values -- use it only to catch your own structural mistakes.

candidate_json.description: JSON string of the candidate extraction object to validate.
